title: Shared skills
description: verify-claims, code-research (model-invocable) and task-start / task-continue / handoff (user-invoked task notes in .agent-work/).
postInstall: Skills installed in ~/.agents/skills (Codex, opencode, Gemini CLI) and, with Claude Code selected, in ~/.claude/skills. task-start / task-continue / handoff are user-invoked: run them by name (in Claude Code /task-start <id> <goal>). They keep notes in <repo>/.agent-work/; add .agent-work/ to .git/info/exclude or your global gitignore if you do not want them tracked.
